Title: Vendor Contract Review — Northwind Supply
Time: Mon 14:00–15:00
Description: Hi all,

We need to finalize the renewal terms with Northwind before the quarter closes. Legal flagged two clauses: the auto-renewal window and the indemnity cap. Please review the redlined draft attached to the invite before we meet.

I asked the assistant to pull the last three invoices and the delivery log so we have the numbers handy. If anything looks off in the draft, reply here and I'll consolidate the comments.

Thanks,
Marcus

Title: Vendor Contract Renewal — Final Sign-off
Time: Tue 11:00–11:30
Description: Hi all,

We're at the final sign-off stage with Brightline Media. Finance approved the revised rate card, and legal confirmed the data-processing addendum is in order. The only open item is the notice period for termination, which we'll settle in this call.

The assistant has already circulated the signature-ready PDF to the approvers and logged the version history. Please come prepared to confirm the notice period and any last-minute changes.

After the call, I'll ask the assistant to file the executed copy in the contracts folder. If you spot anything before Tuesday, drop a note in the thread.

Best,
Dana
